arithmetic.assumptions: Independent producer, CPU analysis and serial device stages; ordinary analysis 8 us/task, replay preparation 7 us/group + 1 us/task. Groups wait for all described tasks and release device work after group preparation. No cold discovery/capture, memory pressure, intra-group CPU/device overlap or communication. These are teaching assumptions, not measured Apophenia or CUDA Graph timings.
